notLive.reason: Requires a Nuxt UI collision fixture with enabled search. Search and its collision-safe alias are slice 2b; page auto-import is exercised by docs-site, but that alone does not prove this full claim.
Requires two ingestion builds with swapped plugin order and a controlled custom plugin; one deployed plugin pipeline cannot prove ordering.
Requires isolated omitted-plugin and empty-plugin builds; this docs-site enables plugins. The unchanged quickstart alone does not establish equivalence.
Requires alternate custom Shiki registrations and setup rejection of theme/langs; docs-site exercises the documented zero-config Shiki variant only.
Requires builds both with and without Nuxt Image; docs-site checks the plain img fallback only and does not install Nuxt Image.
Requires invalid custom ingestion-plugin AST builds that must be rejected; putting them in the production collection would prevent generating the public demo.
Requires a json-render catalog/renderer integration and plugin fixture beyond the documented docs-site setup. No compatible catalog is documented in the supplied installed starting pages.

notLive.reason: Build-only known-failure fixture K002 isolates security plugin rejection of a required false boolean; pnpm check:known-failures records the exact diagnostic.
Full-document rendering is used by docs-site, but the complete claim also requires a resolved Content reference/component fixture; that reference integration needs its own documented fixture.
Production checks verify partials are hidden; proof that their parsed bodies remain available to build tooling requires inspection through a documented build-tool interface, not a public route.
The installed guide states partials are not includes but specifies no include syntax to attempt. A partial link is not a transclusion test; requires a maintainer-defined negative fixture.
A parse/serialize round trip with whitespace and native attributes is a framework-free serializer check, not a deployed visitor flow.
Requires a negative inline-renderer policy fixture that safely captures its rejection; a deliberately throwing page cannot be statically generated alongside the public docs-site.
